# RULE R7: no false criticals / highs. Blood pH needs blood-gas context; a critical never fires on a value the
# lab prints as normal for an assay cut-off (troponin) and hs-TnT is judged in ng/L; blood group / Rh are
# information, not an anomaly; PCT needs a unit or CBC context; negative concentrations are not results.
@@ R7 | M | 40 | bare pH 5.0 is a urine pH
pH 5.0
=> pH | NORMAL | 5.0
=> risk=low
@@ R7 | M | 40 | bare pH 8.5 is an alkaline urine, not a blood pH
pH 8.5
=> pH | HIGH | 8.5
@@ R7 | M | 40 | urine pH
Urine pH 6.5
=> Urine pH | NORMAL | 6.5
@@ R7 | M | 40 | Reaction 7.0 is urine pH
Reaction 7.0
=> Reaction | NORMAL | 7.0
@@ R7 | M | 40 | blood pH 7.1 critical
Blood pH 7.1
=> Blood pH | CRITICAL_LOW | 7.1
@@ R7 | M | 40 | arterial pH 7.62 critical
Arterial pH 7.62
=> Arterial pH | CRITICAL_HIGH | 7.62
@@ R7 | M | 40 | pH (Arterial) 7.30 low
pH (Arterial) 7.30
=> pH (Arterial) | LOW | 7.30
@@ R7 | M | 40 | venous pH normal
Venous pH 7.38
=> Venous pH | NORMAL | 7.38
@@ R7 | M | 40 | blood-gas context makes pH a blood pH
pH 7.1
pCO2 28 mmHg
pO2 95 mmHg
=> pH | CRITICAL_LOW | 7.1
=> pCO2 | LOW | 28
=> pO2 | NORMAL | 95
@@ R7 | M | 40 | arterial blood gas heading
ARTERIAL BLOOD GAS
pH 7.28
pCO2 30 mmHg
=> pH | LOW | 7.28
=> pCO2 | LOW | 30
@@ R7 | M | 40 | urine routine with pH 7.5
URINE ROUTINE EXAMINATION
Specific Gravity 1.015
pH 7.5
=> Specific Gravity | NORMAL | 1.015
=> pH | NORMAL | 7.5
@@ R7 | M | 40 | printed urine range
pH 6.0 4.6-8.0
=> pH | NORMAL | 6.0
@@ R7 | M | 40 | printed blood range, normal
pH 7.40 7.35-7.45
=> pH | NORMAL | 7.40
@@ R7 | M | 40 | printed blood range, critical
pH 7.1 7.35-7.45
=> pH | CRITICAL_LOW | 7.1
@@ R7 | M | 40 | bare pH in the blood/urine ambiguous band is not scored
pH 7.4
=> pH | UNKNOWN | 7.4
=> warn
@@ R7 | M | 40 | hs Troponin T normal
hs Troponin T 9 ng/L <14
=> hs Troponin T | NORMAL | 9
@@ R7 | M | 40 | hs-cTnT
hs-cTnT 8 ng/L 0-14
=> hs-cTnT | NORMAL | 8
@@ R7 | M | 40 | hs troponin T raised but not critical
Troponin T hs 40 ng/L <14
=> Troponin T hs | HIGH | 40
@@ R7 | M | 40 | hs troponin T markedly raised
hs Troponin T 150 ng/L <14
=> hs Troponin T | CRITICAL_HIGH | 150
@@ R7 | M | 40 | troponin I normal
Troponin I 0.02 ng/mL <0.04
=> Troponin I | NORMAL | 0.02
@@ R7 | M | 40 | troponin I critical
Troponin I 0.5 ng/mL <0.04
=> Troponin I | CRITICAL_HIGH | 0.5
@@ R7 | M | 40 | hs troponin I in ng/L normal
hs Troponin I 4 ng/L <34
=> hs Troponin I | NORMAL | 0.004
@@ R7 | M | 40 | hs troponin I just below its cut-off
hs Troponin I 30 ng/L <34
=> hs Troponin I | NORMAL | 0.03
@@ R7 | M | 40 | hs troponin I markedly raised
hs Troponin I 120 ng/L <34
=> hs Troponin I | CRITICAL_HIGH | 0.12
@@ R7 | M | 40 | troponin T in ng/mL normal
Troponin T 0.005 ng/mL
=> Troponin T | NORMAL | 0.005
@@ R7 | M | 40 | troponin I under the lab's own higher cut-off
Troponin I 45 ng/L <50
=> Troponin I | NORMAL | 0.045
@@ R7 | M | 40 | blood group A positive
Blood Group A Positive
=> Blood Group | INFO
=> risk=low
@@ R7 | M | 40 | ABO group B positive
ABO Group B Positive
=> ABO | INFO
@@ R7 | M | 40 | Rh factor negative
Rh Factor Negative
=> Rh Factor | INFO
@@ R7 | M | 40 | Rh type positive
Rh Type Positive
=> Rh Type | INFO
@@ R7 | M | 40 | Rhesus
Rhesus (Rh) Positive
=> Rhesus | INFO
@@ R7 | M | 40 | ABO and Rh on one line
ABO & Rh Typing O Positive
=> ABO | INFO
@@ R7 | M | 40 | antibody screen positive IS an abnormal finding
Irregular Antibody Screen Positive
=> Antibody | POSITIVE
@@ R7 | M | 40 | indirect Coombs positive
Indirect Coombs Test Positive
=> Coombs | POSITIVE
@@ R7 | M | 40 | direct antiglobulin test positive
Direct Antiglobulin Test Positive
=> Antiglobulin | POSITIVE
@@ R7 | M | 40 | urine nitrite positive is abnormal
Urine Nitrite Positive
=> Nitrite | POSITIVE
@@ R7 | M | 40 | PCT with no unit and no CBC is not scored
PCT 0.4
=> PCT | UNKNOWN | 0.4
=> warn
@@ R7 | M | 40 | PCT in ng/mL is procalcitonin
PCT 0.4 ng/mL <0.5
=> PCT | NORMAL | 0.4
@@ R7 | M | 40 | procalcitonin written out
Procalcitonin 12 ng/mL <0.5
=> Procalcitonin | HIGH | 12
@@ R7 | M | 40 | PCT in % is plateletcrit
PCT 0.28 %
=> PCT | NORMAL | 0.28
@@ R7 | M | 40 | PCT on a CBC is plateletcrit
Hemoglobin 14.2 g/dL 13.0-17.0
MCV 90 fL 80-100
PCT 0.25
=> Hemoglobin | NORMAL | 14.2
=> MCV | NORMAL | 90
=> PCT | NORMAL | 0.25
@@ R7 | M | 40 | plateletcrit low
Plateletcrit 0.1 %
=> Plateletcrit | LOW | 0.1
@@ R7 | M | 40 | negative potassium
Potassium -4.1 mmol/L
=> Potassium | UNKNOWN | -4.1
=> warn
@@ R7 | M | 40 | negative creatinine with a printed range
Creatinine -1.0 mg/dL 0.7-1.3
=> Creatinine | UNKNOWN | -1.0
=> warn
@@ R7 | M | 40 | negative haemoglobin
Hemoglobin -13 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | UNKNOWN | -13
=> warn
@@ R7 | M | 40 | negative sodium with a unicode minus
Sodium −140 mmol/L
=> Sodium | UNKNOWN | -140
=> warn
@@ R7 | M | 40 | negative TSH
TSH -2.0 mIU/L 0.4-4.0
=> TSH | UNKNOWN | -2.0
=> warn
@@ R7 | M | 40 | base excess may be negative
Base Excess -4 mmol/L
=> Base Excess | LOW | -4
@@ R7 | M | 40 | a dash separator is not a minus sign
Sodium - 140 mmol/L 135-145
=> Sodium | NORMAL | 140
@@ R7 | M | 40 | colon and dash separator
Potassium : - 4.2 mmol/L 3.5-5.1
=> Potassium | NORMAL | 4.2
